aorist_routes.P: 2.4.77 gives luk of sic after the designated ghu roots with parasmaipada. Hence adāt, adhāt, with 3pl aduḥ or adhuḥ.
aorist_routes.A: 1.2.17 supplies short i in place of the root-final ā and kit status of sic in the middle. Compare adita and adhita, and adiṣātām and adhiṣātām. These are agentive middle forms in the present packet.

perfect: Both P 2sg pairs are attested with -ātha and -itha. The two spellings share one slot. Both P 1sg and 3sg coincide, and A 1sg and 3sg also coincide.
boundary: The root and pada decide the aorist inside the two preverbs. In all four augmented routes, the inner i of ni becomes y.
specific_literary_status: The root commentaries give unprefixed aorists for both padas. The prefixed perfect and aorist schedules are written on their basis; the traditional prefixed presents are catalogued in PG253.
